title: Ludevic & Tevesh — Jekyll/Hyde
summary: A political draw bargain hides distributed draw punishment until one wheel reveals the table-wide kill.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: Underworld Dreams, Fate Unraveler, Razorkin Needlehead, Kederekt Parasite, Nekusar, Scrawling Crawler, and Spiteful Visions turn the offered cards into the primary clock.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Ludevic, Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Kami, Dictate, Temple Bell, Seizan, and Forced Fruition deliberately expand the table's access to cards.

tags.name: wheels
tags.reason: Windfall, Magus of the Wheel, Jace's Archivist, Dark Deal, Burning Inquiry, Wheel and Deal, Molten Psyche, Urza's Guilt, and Khorvath's Fury convert established punishment into closing bursts.

tags.name: discard
tags.reason: Wheels plus Liliana's Caress, Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Waste Not, Bone Miser, and Sangromancer form a complete secondary conversion package.

tags.name: group hug
tags.reason: The offers are genuinely symmetric and Ludevic rewards opponents for damaging one another, even though the bargain eventually turns hostile.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Repeated draw and discard triggers reduce every opposing life total while Sangromancer repays the deck's own life costs.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Ludevic, Temple Bell, Red Death, Khorvath's Fury, and Cerebral Vortex let the pilot choose who receives cards and where combat goes.
